title.narrative: PNG HIV - Papua New Guinea (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Papua New Guinea, HIV, Oil Search Foundation (OSHF)This program has the following goals: To limit the impact of HIV and other STIs and minimise their impact on individuals, families and communities by focussing our prevention efforts on key populations in key areas and improving access to treatment and care services in these key areas for everyone. The objectives of this program are: Improve systems and practices to enable better utilisation of HIV strategic information (HIS). Reduce the risk of HIV and STI transmission for key populations by improving access to prevention programmes and improving links to appropriate clinical services. Strengthen and improve access to quality HIV counselling, testing, care, treatment and support services for all people irrespective of age, gender and sexual orientation
